args.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE independently painted high-definition transparent 2D RPG animation frame, character 14 snow summoner girl, a harmless battle hit reaction.
Reference image 1 is the exact character identity and costume. Reference image 2 is the exact left-facing W side view, body proportions, framing, and carrying arrangement. Reference image 3 is the approved STYLE only: clean bright rounded Chinese Daoist chibi hand-painted finish, soft detailed fur and cloth. No UI.
Identity: silver short bob hair, white furry ears, purple eye, snowflake ornament on anatomical LEFT temple, white/lilac fur-trimmed short robe, purple belt with silver fox-face buckle and blue crystal charms, bare knees and short fur-trimmed boots. Anatomical LEFT arm (near camera in W) cradles exactly one small white fox at LEFT ribs, LEFT hand naturally supports fox. Anatomical RIGHT palm (far side) carries exactly one small blue snowflake crystal, extended toward screen LEFT. Preserve all held objects and their original hands. No girl's tail, staff, new weapon or extra limbs.
Camera: strict left side profile facing screen LEFT, one visible girl eye; maintain reference W camera, do not rotate the chest, pelvis or feet toward camera. Both boots point LEFT. Exact same childlike head size in every frame.
Composition: one full-body sprite only on genuine alpha transparency, native square canvas at least 1024x1024. At normalized 1024 scale use fixed virtual ground y=942 and body root x=520. Idle ear-tip y=80, same overall camera scale; ears/head may move naturally with recoil. Do not center or enlarge the bent silhouette. Keep entire boots, ears, fingers and crystal inside canvas with margins. Keep clean natural antialiased edges with no saturated blue/magenta keying fringe. No text, floor, shadow, border, background, sheet, grid, particles, beam or impact effect. Highest faithful painted detail.

Reference image 4 is the newly drawn W01 onset, to keep exact head size, same virtual camera, planted boot positions and rendering. Advance into the new phase below; do not duplicate the onset pose.
Frame W02 of 06, rising recoil: impact from screen LEFT pushes shoulders 20 pixels toward screen RIGHT, chest leans 8 degrees backward, head follows, knees flex 12 degrees. One visible eye narrows in a flinch, small open mouth. LEFT forearm protects fox closer to ribs; RIGHT elbow bends and retracts crystal 24 pixels toward chest and 6 pixels upward from idle. Both boots remain planted facing LEFT; near knee shifts forward for balance.
